The '''Avium Savannah''' is a large plain located within [[Varlamore]], just south of [[Civitas illa Fortis]]. The [[Colossal Wyrm]] was known to inhabit the Savannah,{{CiteText|text=Bloody diary|quote=In my travels throughout the Shining Kingdom, I have bested many mighty creatures. From the Colossal Wyrm of the Avium Savannah to the Cloud Titan of Tempestus, I am proud to proclaim myself as a master slayer.}} whose [[Colossal Wyrm Remains|remains]] can be found at the southern part of the savannah.

Alongside the [[Hunter Guild]], the savannah also contains the [[Locus Oasis]], the [[Stonecutter Outpost]], as well as a large diversity of hunter creatures. Aggressive [[jaguars]] can also be found east of the [[Sunset Coast]].

==Transportation==
The player must first travel to Civitas illa Fortis via [[Regulus Cento]] after completing [[Children of the Sun]] before other transportation methods become usable.
* The [[Fairy rings|fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|ajp}} is located in the centre of the savannah.
* The [[Quetzal Transport System]], unlocked during [[Twilight's Promise]], has several landing zones in the savannah: one by the entrance to the [[Hunter Guild]], one in [[Outer Fortis]], and one by the [[Colossal Wyrm Remains]]. The latter two require a [[landing site]] to be built.
* The [[Hunter cape]] or [[max cape]] teleports players inside the Hunter Guild. Speak to [[Guildmaster Apatura]] with either cape equipped or in your inventory and she will unlock the teleport, after a brief conversation.
* A [[quetzal whistle]] takes players to the Hunter Guild's landing site. Quetzal whistles can be unlocked after completing 10 [[Hunters' Rumours]].
* [[Civitas illa Fortis Teleport]] can be used after [[Twilight's Promise]], and is near a quetzal landing site.
